sql: SELECT lower(fl.action) a, lower(fl.side) s, count(*) n, count(fl.quantity) nq, count(fl.price) np, round(sum(fl.fee),4) fee, min(fl.price) minp, max(fl.price) maxp, (SELECT string_agg(k, ',') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_object_keys(fl2.raw_fill_json::jsonb) k FROM fills fl2 WHERE split_part(fl2.market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBTOTAL' LIMIT 40) z) keys FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders lo ON lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id WHERE lo.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXMLBTOTAL','KXMLBSPREAD') GROUP BY 1,2
